utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... all right. Okay, number 9, Dzemal. Certainly not a Serbian name. Right?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: Well. It's an interesting name, a lovely name.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ...

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: But I don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ...

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: He's a Muslim or not.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ...

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: It could be a Muslim name. It could be. Mostly it's a Muslim name.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Number 11.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: Same thing.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ...

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: I could say the same thing about each and every one of these.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: And number 13?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: Same thing.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: Damir. It's international, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Well, it could be. Could very well be that they had an international staff on this -- and a multi-ethnic one at that, at this radio station, which may negate some of your -- your assertions, sir, that the Muslims were ethnically cleansed from the radio station. That's the whole point of the discussion here, and I hope that the Trial Chamber sees that and also takes note of your attitude in being disputatious and at least pointing out what names are or are not Muslim, at least by -- by the looks of them. Okay?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: Excuse me. I'm not challenging whether these names are Muslim or not. I'm just wondering about the people behind the names.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: I think that's a legitimate issue.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: [Previous translation continues] ... I --

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: You can't simply.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: I'll take that answer.

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: Tell me, assure me that some of these people are Muslims if in fact you don't know.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay. Thank you. Well, I wanted you to point out the names but, fine, we'll move on. The next document is 1D 01417. And this is dated November 5, 1992, and these are the employees of the radio station. Again, and I don't want to go through this list again, but would you agree with me that there are Muslim names? We don't know whether the people behind the names are Muslim. They could be Greek for all I know, but at least the names themselves look -- there are names that are Muslim, and there are several of them; right?

utterances.speaker: ALIJA LIZDE
utterances.text: Yes, there are Muslim names.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Your Honour, I'm going to need about five to perhaps seven minutes, you know, maybe 10 tomorrow, and I know that we want to make sure that we end on time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: MR. KARNAVAS
utterances.text: Thank you very much, sir. You have a lovely evening. We'll see you tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Fine. So we will resume tomorrow with Mr. Karnavas who will have 10 minutes to finish. Witness, please, you are now under oath. So you can have no contact with Prosecution, and you should see no one until tomorrow. We will resume tomorrow at 2.15 p.m. Thank you for coming back for this hearing tomorrow at 2.15.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 2nd day of May, 2007, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 6.59 p.m.,
